thesis: v3.2에서 NVDA는 Growth 적격이다. LTG는 77.5점이지만 market_misperception 50이 Outlier Growth 하한 65에 못 미친다. 모든 Hard Veto는 cleared지만 현재가 $222.27가 Base $212.86을 약 4.4% 상회하고 Bear $74.99까지 하방 폭이 크며, 지원 대상 고객 매출·AR와 실제 고객 ROI가 미공개다. 따라서 Growth 초기 상한 1–3%를 그대로 쓰지 않고 STARTER 1–2%를 승인하며 macro pacing 0.5로 분할 집행한다.

evidence.claim: v3.2 aggregate score is 70.19 (Emerging Outlier); Growth is the only eligible archetype with fit score ~71.15.
Long-Term Growth scores 77.5, but market_misperception is 50 versus the required 65, so Outlier Growth is not eligible.
All nine Hard Vetoes are cleared after RT completed co-owner review; no pending structural geopolitical reanalysis remains.
Locked valuation is Bear $74.99, Base $212.86, Bull $431.14 versus current price $222.27; price/Base is ~1.044x.
Q2 FY27 revenue was $96.221B with 75.0% gross margin, H1 customer advances were $15.6B, and H1 operating cash flow was about $74.4B, supporting real customer demand and self-funded growth.
Macro overlay leaves fundamentals unchanged but sets purchase pacing to 0.5 because high Middle East energy/shipping stress is the binding global overlay.

counterevidence: Current price is above the locked Base value, so the thesis does not have a conventional valuation margin of safety.
Bear value is far below current price, reflecting severe downside if AI infrastructure returns normalize faster than expected.
AR growth, extended payment terms, $36B AI-cloud agreements and $108.5B maximum guarantee exposure leave demand-quality uncertainty.
Hyperscaler custom ASICs and export controls can erode pricing power even if near-term revenue remains strong.
unknowns: Supported/invested customers' share of total revenue and AR.
Customer-side AI infrastructure utilization, ROI and payback.
$279B supply/capacity commitments' firm-order versus adjustable share.
Actual phase-by-phase exposure and recovery economics of the SB Energy/OpenAI guarantees.
Rubin cost-per-token advantage versus leading custom ASICs at comparable utilization.
falsifiers: Data Center revenue declines y/y for two consecutive quarters while gross margin falls below 70%.
Supported-customer revenue/AR exceeds 25% or DSO remains elevated while credit support and guarantees continue to expand.
Owner FCF/share falls below the locked Base path for multiple periods and a refrozen Base value remains below market without stronger moat evidence.

key_kpis.name: Owner FCF/share vs locked Base path
key_kpis.threshold: stay on or above Base path

key_kpis.name: DSO / supported-customer revenue and AR
key_kpis.threshold: DSO toward <=50 days and support-linked exposure <25%

next_checks: Q3 FY27 10-Q: AR, DSO, customer advances, allowance, commitments and any supported-customer disclosure.
Rubin deployment and independent cost/performance evidence versus hyperscaler custom ASICs.
PORTS-Pike guarantee activation, OpenAI credit status and actual recovery/revenue-share economics.

plain_language.business: NVIDIA는 AI 데이터센터에 필요한 GPU, 네트워킹, 소프트웨어 생태계를 함께 판매한다. 현재 매출과 현금창출은 매우 강하지만, 고객의 대규모 AI 투자와 NVIDIA의 지원 약정이 얼마나 지속 가능한지는 계속 확인해야 한다.
plain_language.opportunity: v3.2 기준에서 향후 3년 매출 성장 추정치와 고객가치·현금창출 조건을 통과해 Growth 유형에 들어왔다. 장기 성장 규모와 조직 적응력은 강하지만, 현재 가격에서 시장이 장기 사실을 과소평가한다는 증거는 부족해 Outlier Growth로 승격하지 않는다.
plain_language.risk: 현재 가격은 하네스의 Base 가치보다 약간 높고 Bear 시나리오에서는 손실 폭이 크다. 또한 고객 지원, 보증, 매출채권 증가와 자체 ASIC 경쟁이 장기 수익성을 훼손할 수 있다.
plain_language.decision_reason: 중대한 탈락 사유는 모두 해소됐지만 가격과 수요의 질에 대한 불확실성이 크다. 그래서 정상 비중이 아니라 1~2% Starter 범위만 승인하고, 거시환경 때문에 실제 매수 속도는 평소의 절반 수준으로 제한한다.

rerun_note: Updated for v3.2 after adding the formal LG report; decision remains STARTER Growth.
